name: Midas mMEV
oneLiner: mMEV is a Midas NAV-accreting liquid-yield token wrapping MEV Capital's DeFi lending, liquidity, arbitrage, and liquidation strategies; not a fixed $1 peg.
collateral: MEV Capital-managed DeFi lending, liquidity, arbitrage, carry, and liquidation strategies allocated through Midas liquid-yield token rails.
pegMechanism: Midas NAV-accreting liquid-yield token with primary mint/redeem through Midas rails; it does not maintain a fixed $1 redemption floor.

proofOfReserves.provider: Midas transparency dashboard and issuer disclosures

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes: Midas mMEV is a permissioned liquid-yield token with issuer/admin control surfaces around minting, redemption, transfer administration, and upgradeable protocol contracts.

reserves.name: MEV Capital DeFi lending, liquidity, arbitrage, carry, and liquidation strategies

mintAuthority.summary: mMEV is a Midas liquid-yield token; new units are minted only by Midas's permissioned issuance role (MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE) when greenlisted users deposit through the Midas DepositVault, with NAV conversion settled off-chain by the issuer.

controls.label: Midas issuance manager (MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE / DepositVault)
controls.evidence: Midas vault architecture mints the token via a permissioned MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE through the DepositVault against greenlisted deposits; conversion rate is set off-chain by the issuer and token/vault contracts are upgradeable behind MidasAccessControl.

review.evidence: Midas liquid-yield tokens are minted and redeemed exclusively through Midas's permissioned DepositVault/RedemptionVault contracts gated by MidasAccessControl roles (greenlist + mint operator); no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route exists. On-chain owner/role holders not independently read.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the live on-chain MidasAccessControl role holders and any bridge admin for the Plume/Etherlink deployments before raising confidence.
